Title: Janek Supply Line
Description: Secure the Janek supply corridor, protect a vital convoy and intercept the raiders behind the attacks.

Steps.Title: Janek: Silent Watch
Steps.Brief: Map the patrol corridor and identify threats to civilian traffic.

Steps.Title: Janek: Convoy Shield
Steps.Brief: Escort the convoy through the corridor secured by the preceding patrol.

Steps.Title: Janek: Broken Spear
Steps.Brief: Intercept the raider group identified during the convoy attack.

Title: Jarnell Convoy Watch
Description: Protect Jarnell shipping and break up the force hunting its freighters.

Steps.Title: Jarnell: Convoy Shield
Steps.Brief: Keep the convoy intact and report the hostile approach vector.

Steps.Title: Jarnell: Broken Spear
Steps.Brief: Use the convoy report to intercept the raiders before their next attack.

Title: Iron Vigil
Description: Defend Marak against intruders through patrol and interception.

Steps.Title: Marak: Silent Watch
Steps.Brief: Establish a patrol picture around Marak and report unauthorized ships.

Steps.Title: Marak: Broken Spear
Steps.Brief: Intercept the hostile force identified by the patrol.

Title: Loris Border Watch
Description: Reassert control of the Loris border shipping lanes.

Steps.Title: Loris: Silent Watch
Steps.Brief: Patrol the border lanes and confirm the intrusion.

Steps.Title: Loris: Broken Spear
Steps.Brief: Respond to the patrol report and intercept the intruding force.

Title: Haiche Safe Passage
Description: Defend local commerce while tracing the source of attacks.

Steps.Title: Haiche: Convoy Shield
Steps.Brief: Escort the threatened freighters and collect the attack report.

Steps.Title: Haiche: Broken Spear
Steps.Brief: Intercept the force exposed by the convoy encounter.

Title: Silessia Trade Guard
Description: Survey the Silessia trade lanes before committing to convoy protection.

Steps.Title: Silessia: Silent Watch
Steps.Brief: Patrol the trade approaches and clear the route for the next convoy.

Steps.Title: Silessia: Convoy Shield
Steps.Brief: Escort the convoy through the surveyed trade corridor.

Title: The Other Side of the Line
Description: Opposed-side story assignments. Campaign numbers are narrative references; agents own acceptance and progression.

Steps.Title: Aram: Watch on the Border
Steps.Brief: A missing Alliance reconnaissance ship has brought the carrier Archon into Aram. Hegemony Command considers this an armed incursion. Screen Orten while identifying and driving off the incoming Alliance patrol. Do not pursue the carrier beyond the border picket.

Steps.Title: Loris: Wings of Iron
Steps.Brief: Alliance strike package Condor is closing on the supply freighter Ascentia. Those holds sustain the Loris garrison. Break the bomber attack and keep the freighter intact; the Alliance escort is a secondary threat.

Steps.Title: Tantalus: Hold the Line
Steps.Brief: An Alliance strike is crossing the line above the Tantalus mining works. From the Hegemony side this is a raid on a working supply installation. Protect the station and intercept Alpha before its ordnance reaches the refinery.

Steps.Title: Lornas: Deny the Hammer
Steps.Brief: The carrier Archon has launched Mustang against our destroyer Sidus. Keep the strike fighters off the ship while Sidus withdraws under Orinoco's screen. Hegemony command needs this force intact for the Renser defense.

Steps.Title: Shadow Canyon: Unbroken Shield
Steps.Brief: Alliance flight Echo is attempting to suppress the defenses of Shadow Canyon. Hold the starbase perimeter, intercept the attackers and preserve the landing corridor for our returning crews.

Steps.Title: Paragon: Turn the Hunt
Steps.Brief: Alliance cruisers Wraith and Nemesis are hunting our Paragon screen. Take command of the counterattack, protect Parthan and force the leading cruiser out of the approach lane. Neutral shipping is to be left alone.

Steps.Title: Korius: The Other Sky
Steps.Brief: Antares has committed a carrier group over Korius. Hegemony liaison command orders a fighter screen around Goliath while the allied Dantari force reorganizes. Contain the Alliance escort; the opposing carrier is not your primary target.

Title: Highland: A Separatist Account
Description: Opposed-side story assignments. Campaign numbers are narrative references; agents own acceptance and progression.

Steps.Title: Solus: Hold the Blockade
Steps.Brief: Alliance forces have answered the Directorate appeal and Archon is entering the courier corridor. To the Separatist fleet this is foreign intervention. Support our blockade patrol and intercept the carrier's advancing fighter screen.

Steps.Title: Solus: The Undelivered Order
Steps.Brief: A Directorate courier carries orders intended to consolidate the failed coup's aftermath. Stop the military dispatch before it reaches the Alliance liaison. Expect Vanguard to protect the courier.

Steps.Title: Kalon: Challenge at Harmony
Steps.Brief: The Directorate is using Harmony Station to stage Alliance support. Escort Kalon Strike into the approach corridor and break the Avengers screen. Civilian berths are outside your engagement orders.

Steps.Title: Trellis: Close the Corridor
Steps.Brief: Alliance fighters have opened a relief corridor at Trellis. Our command claims the same route is moving Directorate war supplies. Interdict the armed escort while our strike group inspects the shipping lane.

Steps.Title: Renser: Eyes Beyond the Border
Steps.Brief: Our Hegemony liaison reports an Alliance picket watching the Renser buildup. Cover the scouts as they recover their sensor records and disengage. This patrol is intelligence work, not an invasion of the picket line.

Steps.Title: Meridian: The Observatory Screen
Steps.Brief: The Directorate observatory at Tal Vesta is feeding tracking data to Alliance ships. Kendra and Pelorat are exposed to an approaching relief flight. Break its fighter screen and protect the Separatist ships; avoid the civilian research structures.

Steps.Title: Solus: Words and Weapons
Steps.Brief: Accusations over Renser have hardened both fleets. Hold a defensive cordon around the liaison interceptors while the Alliance moves Stalwart into the area. Defeat the advance fighters and preserve our evidence relay.

Steps.Title: Trellis: A Dangerous Mandate
Steps.Brief: The Senate resolution gives the Alliance a mandate we do not recognize. Escort our inspection group through the Trellis approach and challenge the armed escort. The relief transport itself is not a combat objective.

Steps.Title: Jalah: Bring Them Home
Steps.Brief: The fleet is falling back to Jalah. Rear Guard must hold long enough for the scattered crews to return. Protect it from the Alliance fighter screen and keep the withdrawal route open.

Steps.Title: Khaital: The Price of Intervention
Steps.Brief: Archon and Stalwart are pressing into Khaital. The Dantari liaison flight must protect Ironhelm and Mattock while the defensive force reforms. Defeat the carrier's fighter screen without abandoning the withdrawal line.

Title: Hegemony Campaign 2
Description: Marakan account of the campaign, issued through local officers. The campaign number is a narrative reference; this does not replace the Terellian campaign.

Steps.Title: Solus: Hold the Cordon
Steps.Brief: Archon is advancing into Solus behind an Alliance fighter screen. Protect Blockade Patrol and intercept Avengers before the cordon is scattered. The carrier itself is not your flight's objective.

Steps.Title: Solus: Seal the Dispatch
Steps.Brief: A Directorate courier is trying to carry emergency orders through our allied patrol. Escort Separatist Pursuit into position and break Vanguard's escort screen. Preserve the liaison ships; do not chase the courier into civilian traffic.

Steps.Title: Kalon: Challenge the Screen
Steps.Brief: Harmony Station has become an anchor for Alliance support. Escort Kalon Strike into the approach lane, defeat Avengers and preserve the strike group. Civilian berths remain protected.

Steps.Title: Trellis: Close the Breach
Steps.Brief: The Alliance has opened a passage through the Trellis approaches. Support our patrol while it reforms the cordon, and defeat Avengers before they can widen the breach. Neutral vessels are to be left clear.

Steps.Title: Renser: Forward Eyes
Steps.Brief: Our scouts have detected an Alliance picket watching the Renser approaches. Protect Hegemony Scouts while their records are relayed to command. Intercept Vanguard before it can fix our withdrawal vector.

Steps.Title: Meridian: Rescue the Screen
Steps.Brief: Kendra is exposed near the Tal Vesta observatory as Alliance relief fighters arrive. Cover the ship and defeat Vanguard. Your orders concern the armed escort, not the civilian research complex.

Steps.Title: Solus: Shield the Liaison
Steps.Brief: The accusations over Renser are bringing Stalwart forward. Our liaison interceptors must remain on station long enough to confirm the fleet movement. Screen them against Vanguard and keep a route clear for recovery.

Steps.Title: Trellis: Armed Passage
Steps.Brief: Alliance fighters are escorting a transport through the Trellis cordon. Protect our inspection flight and challenge the armed escort. Relief passengers and civilian crews are outside your engagement orders.

Steps.Title: Jalah: Cover the Withdrawal
Steps.Brief: The Dantari force is falling back toward Jalah. Hegemony liaison command has committed your flight to cover Separatist Rear Guard. Stop Vanguard from disrupting the withdrawal and bring our crews home.

Steps.Title: Khaital: Ironhelm Relief
Steps.Brief: Archon and Stalwart are pressing our Khaital line. Ironhelm needs time to regroup under Mattock's cover. Break Vanguard's advance and keep the defensive group intact.

Title: Hegemony Campaign 3
Description: Marakan account of the campaign, issued through local officers. The campaign number is a narrative reference; this does not replace the Terellian campaign.

Steps.Title: Janek: Forward Spear
Steps.Brief: The Janek forward screen is exposed while our spearhead reforms. Defend the picket, destroy the Alliance interception flight and recover before our carriers shift station. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Vanguard and recover to your carrier.

Steps.Title: Borova: Hold the Approach
Steps.Brief: Borova is the hinge of the advance. Hold the approach against an Alliance counterattack while the forward wing refuels; preserve the assigned defense flight. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Pursuit and recover to your carrier.

Steps.Title: Borova: Turn the Counterstroke
Steps.Brief: Alliance scouts have located our Borova staging lane. Break the counterstroke and protect the ships forming the next sortie. Do not chase beyond the recovery corridor. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Pursuit and recover to your carrier.

Steps.Title: Borova: Diplomatic Cordon
Steps.Brief: Diplomatic traffic is crossing the contested Borova perimeter. Keep armed Alliance interceptors away from the protected liaison unit. Civilian traffic is not a target. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Interceptors and recover to your carrier.

Steps.Title: Pallas: Hold the Spearhead
Steps.Brief: The Pallas spearhead is isolated from its escorts. Clear the Alliance fighter screen, keep the marked Hegemony unit alive and recover to the carrier. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Fighters and recover to your carrier.

Steps.Title: Borova: Rearguard Vigil
Steps.Brief: A rear guard is buying time for the Borova withdrawal. Intercept the pursuing Alliance flights and prevent them from overrunning the protected element. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Rear Guard and recover to your carrier.

Steps.Title: Silessia: A Clear Corridor
Steps.Brief: Our Silessia passage is threatened by Alliance reconnaissance flights. Clear the corridor while the marked unit crosses, then return rather than pursuing into another sector. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Interceptors and recover to your carrier.

Steps.Title: Vesta: No Safe Harbor
Steps.Brief: Brotherhood raiders are exploiting the Vesta withdrawal. Defeat the pirate screen and protect the assigned Hegemony unit. This is a recovery action, not an attack on civilian shipping. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Supply Tender and recover to your carrier.

Title: Hegemony Campaign 4
Description: Marakan account of the campaign, issued through local officers. The campaign number is a narrative reference; this does not replace the Terellian campaign.

Steps.Title: Aram: Outpost Relief
Steps.Brief: Aram outpost requests immediate relief. Protect its local defense force and stop the Alliance interception flight before it can pin down the relief ships. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Outpost Patrol and recover to your carrier.

Steps.Title: Tarsus: The Ambassador's Wake
Steps.Brief: The ambassador route through Tarsus is compromised. Defend the liaison element against armed interceptors and keep the recovery lane clear. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Rogue Interceptors and recover to your carrier.

Steps.Title: Tarsus: An Unwelcome Ally
Steps.Brief: Unknown Zolon craft have entered the Tarsus engagement. Prioritize the alien attackers threatening the protected unit. Do not treat this as another routine Alliance patrol. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Supply Tender and recover to your carrier.

Steps.Title: Loris: Lifeline Under Fire
Steps.Brief: Loris supply tenders are exposed during the retreat. Escort the protected tender through the marked lane and destroy Brotherhood raiders before they reach it. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Supply Tender and recover to your carrier.

Steps.Title: Kolchev: Preserve the Picket
Steps.Brief: The Kolchev picket must survive to warn the next defensive line. Defend the marked interceptors, defeat the Alliance screen and recover without sacrificing the picket. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Interceptors and recover to your carrier.

Title: Hegemony Campaign 5
Description: A Hegemony campaign against the Zolon threat: defend recovery lanes, protect evacuations and preserve the homeward corridor. Zolons are not a playable empire.

Steps.Title: Garrison: Night Watch
Steps.Brief: Zolon probes have appeared near Garrison. Defend the Hegemony picket and destroy the alien scouts before they fix the recovery route. The Zolons are the enemy; you remain a Hegemony pilot. Your assigned craft is Avenger. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Picket and recover to your carrier.

Steps.Title: Radix: Crossroads Guard
Steps.Brief: Zolon strike craft are crossing Radix. Protect the interceptor screen holding the junction and stop the alien attack before it cuts our withdrawal route. Your assigned craft is Avenger. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Interceptors and recover to your carrier.

Steps.Title: Ramek: Keep the Bay Open
Steps.Brief: Alien attackers are closing on Ramek. Keep the defense wing alive and the bay approach clear so damaged crews can recover. Break the Zolon attack and return to the carrier. Your assigned craft is Avenger. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Ramek Defense Wing and recover to your carrier.

Steps.Title: Garrison: Last Laboratory Guard
Steps.Brief: Zolon forces threaten Garrison Military Laboratory during the evacuation of its technical staff. Defend the facility and defeat the alien strike screen; no attack on neutral rescuers is authorized. Your assigned craft is Avenger. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Garrison Military Laboratory and recover to your carrier.

Steps.Title: Volante: The Rear Guard
Steps.Brief: The Zolon pursuit has reached Volante. Protect the Hegemony rear guard, destroy the pursuing alien flights and preserve the final recovery corridor for surviving crews. Your assigned craft is Avenger. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Rear Guard and recover to your carrier.
